subject: Request: Access snapshot + new-joiner training attestation (Q4 evidence)
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena@veridian.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: compliance@veridian.com
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Access snapshot + training attestation for SIG/SOC2 prep

Hi Nikhil,

We're kicking off our intake for the SIG + SOC 2 spot review and need a few artifacts from Redwood covering personnel onboarding/offboarding and training for the last 90 days. Can you provide: 

- A machine-readable access snapshot (CSV) of active accounts and IAM groups as of 2026-11-07, including role/permission mappings and account creation dates.
- A signed attestation that all new hires from 2026-08-01 to 2026-11-07 completed the mandatory security training prior to account provisioning (or a note where training was deferred).
- Any offboarding log excerpts for separations in that same window (redacted PII is fine).

Target ETA: EOD Tuesday 2026-11-09 if possible. If you need a narrower scope (by team or region) let me know — Veridian is particularly interested in engineering/cloud infra and customer data access roles.

Also note: our auditor will ask for a brief statement on redaction methodology (what fields were redacted, why, and who approved).

Thanks,
Lena Park
Senior Compliance Manager
Veridian Systems

P.S. If there's a secure drive or signed link you prefer, we can accept that instead of inline attachments.

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Park <lena@veridian.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Access snapshot + training attestation for SIG/SOC2 prep

Hi Lena — thanks for the heads up.

We can get the access snapshot and training attestation to you by EOD Tuesday. A few clarifying asks to make sure we deliver exactly what you need: 

1) Scope: we'll include engineering and cloud infra teams by default. Confirm if you also want product/support.
2) Redaction policy: we plan to redact PII (home address, SSN, personal emails) and provide a redaction manifest (field name -> reason/approver). Is that acceptable to your auditor?
3) Signed attestation: we can provide a DocuSign-signed PDF. Do you need the attestation from HR (Marissa) or from security leadership (Aditya)? We can include both signatures if required.

Marissa — can you pull the training attestation spreadsheet and offboard logs and put them in a secure drive link? Aditya — can you generate the access snapshot CSV (as-of 2026-11-07) and include role mappings.

I will coordinate delivery and include a short redaction methodology note.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Head of Sales Operations (acting compliance contact)
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

- access_snapshot_20261107.csv (generated by Security Ops; includes username, internal_id (hashed), role, team, account_created_at, last_login, primary_group)
- training_attestation_q4_2026.xlsx (columns: internal_id (hashed), name (redacted to initials), hire_date, training_completed_date, trainer_id, notes)

- Email addresses removed except for corporate email where required for mapping
- Approver: Marissa Cole (HR Lead)

Location: secure drive (Veridian access granted): https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/Veridian/SOC2/Q4-2026/
DocuSign attestation is queued; I'll send the signed PDF once countersigned.

Let me know if you need CSV column expansion (we can include MFA status per account but will need slightly more time).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, People Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: access_snapshot_20261107.csv, training_attestation_q4_2026.xlsx, offboard_log_excerpt_202609-10.pdf

Thanks Marissa — that's exactly what we need. Two quick follow-ups: 

- Auditor requests the MFA status column; if you can add a boolean 'mfa_enrolled' in the access CSV that would close that gap. If it's easier, a short note confirming "All engineering/cloud infra accounts have MFA enforced" is sufficient.
- Please go ahead and send the DocuSign-signed attestation from HR; we only need HR's signature for the personnel training attestation. Security's provisioning statement can be uploaded separately.

Once we have the signed attestation and the MFA confirmation, we'll mark the item as delivered on our checklist. Appreciate the fast turnaround and the redaction manifest — that will make the auditor's life easier.

Best,
Lena Park
Senior Compliance Manager
